title: Robert Dudley, Arcano del mare, autograph draft vol. III (America), "Alcune Parole della lingua Indiana di Trinidada et de Guiana"
date: before 1636 (draft of Arcano del mare, printed 1646); words collected on Dudley's 1594-95 voyage
language_as_named: lingua Indiana di Trinidada et de Guiana
modern_id: Arawakan/Cariban of Trinidad & Orinoco; probably Lokono (Arawak, araw1276) and/or Shebayo (sheb1234) - unclear
size: c. 60-80 Italian-glossed words on one map/text sheet (body parts, metals, weapons, food, tobacco, canoe, captain)
evidence: 'Seque d'Alcune Parole della lingua Indiana di Trinidada et de Guiana' ... 'Dacabbo - la mano', 'Weenah - Il Celo', 'Canoa - una Barchetta'
novelty_basis: Glottolog Arawak refs list Warner 1899 (Hakluyt Soc., Voyage of Robert Dudley) which prints the English (Wyatt) vocabulary; this Italian autograph-draft witness in Munich is not cited in Glottolog or (as far as found) in linguistic literature. Shebayo refs: de Laet 1633 only pre-1900.
notes: Independent manuscript witness to the 1595 Trinidad word list, re-transcribed by Dudley in Florence with Italian glosses; worth collating against Warner 1899 and the printed 1646/1661 Arcano. OCR poor; read from images.

title: T. F. Ehrmann, Geschichte der merkwürdigsten Reisen, Bd. 6: 'Verzeichniß einiger Wörter aus der jaloffischen, fulischen und mandingoischen Sprache'
size: c. 18 pp., several hundred German-keyed entries in 3 columns
evidence: Columns 'Deutsch Jaloffisch Fulisch Mandingoisch': 'Der Elefant gnay ghiova samma', 'Das Feuer safara ... dimbau'
novelty_basis: Listed in Glottolog references (Ehrmann 1791-97, Verzeichniß einiger Wörter aus der jaloffischen...).
notes: Compiled from French sources; the 'Wolof c.1798' lead from IA pass is probably this or derivative.
